label: Tools
description: Search, filter, and compare component specifications. Each tool includes the explanations you need to interpret its results.
schwalbeTireSelectorDescription: Search and filter the Schwalbe tire catalog by model and size, with tire construction and specification explanations.
brandWheelsetSpokeSpecsDescription: Filter by brand or search a wheelset model to find spoke lengths, lacing patterns, and nipple specifications, with repair-kit notes.
spokeLengthCalculatorDescription: Calculate front and rear spoke lengths with the full rim, hub, lacing, correction, and nipple wizard, including measurement and result guidance.
spokeLacingTopologySimulatorDescription: Preview spoke hole positions, lacing patterns, G3 and 2:1 layouts, and dual-flange geometry, with explanations and preview limits.
dynamicTirePressureCalculatorDescription: Explore how load, pressure, speed, and lean change estimated tire contact area and cornering force.
spokeStressReliefMechanicsDescription: Calculate axial spoke elongation from material, section, length, and working tension inputs with the full engineering context.
valveLengthFitmentCalculatorDescription: Complete inner-tube size, valve, material, and deep-rim valve-length guidance with an interactive fitment calculator.
freehubCassetteFitmentEngineDescription: Match cassette standards, freehub bodies, spacers, and mechanical fitment rules with the complete guide.
